admin.title: Federation
admin.subtitle: Chat and share with other Crewhall installations
admin.enableHint: While on, the organization's discovery document is published and people can chat with peered installations. Turning it off stops new messages; the history stays.
admin.fingerprintHint: Compare this value with the other installation's admin before adding the peer.
admin.allowedHint: Only these domains can become peers. *.example.com covers subdomains. Adding a peer also adds its domain here.
admin.addPeerHint: Enter the other installation's domain; the peering turns active once they add you too.
admin.requested: They added you and are waiting for you to accept
admin.waiting: Waiting for them to add you
admin.removeConfirm: Stop federating with {domain}? Shared conversations stay read-only.
admin.off: Federation is off. Turning it on creates the organization key so you can add peers.

chat.readOnly: Federation with this installation is off right now; messages are not sent there.
chat.addRemoteHint: Enter their address (e.g. ayse@hub.example.com). Both installations need to be peered.

share.title: Send to someone on another installation
share.hint: A share link is created and sent to them in chat; the file stays here.

shared.title: Shared channels
shared.hint: Share a space channel with a peered organization; members of both write in the same channel and each organization keeps its own copy.
shared.enableHint: The other organization has to turn them on too. While off, invites can't be sent or received.
shared.maxFileHint: Largest single file sent to or taken from another organization.
shared.empty: No shared channels or invites yet.
shared.acceptHint: The channel opens as a channel of the space you pick; its members see it and write in it. Earlier messages don't come over.
shared.name: Channel name
shared.leaveConfirm: Leave {name}? The channel stays here as a read-only archive.
shared.removeConfirm: Remove {org} from {name}? Their copy becomes a read-only archive.
shared.shareTitle: Share the channel with another organization
shared.shareHint: Once the other organization's admin accepts, members of both write in this channel. Each keeps its own copy of the messages; history isn't shared.
shared.banner: This channel is shared with other organizations: {domains}. What you write goes to their copies too.
shared.bannerGuest: This channel belongs to {org}. What you write goes to them and the channel's other organizations.
shared.archived: Sharing with this organization ended; the channel is read-only.
shared.foldersHint: Link a folder of the space to the channel; every organization the channel is shared with keeps its own copy and changes sync both ways (within a minute).
shared.foldersGuestHint: Folders the host organization shared. The copy lives in this organization's Drive; changes you make here go to them too.
shared.foldersEmpty: No shared folders in this channel.
